 Match Predictions: ICC CWC League 2 2026 - Match 143 - UAE vs Netherlands - October 31st
 Match Predictions: ICC CWC League 2 2026 - Match 143 ©REUTERS 
 By Cricket World 
 Friday 30 October 2026 
 ICC CWC League 2 
 ODI series Schedule 143rd ODI, Dubai Live United Arab Emirates 0/0 Netherlands NED elected to bat
 Netherlands elected to bat
 Live scores and commentary 
 Here are the Predictions for the ICC CWC League 2 2026, Match 143 - UAE vs Netherlands, to be played on the 31st of October at the ICC Academy, Dubai.
 Match Prediction - United Arab Emirates v Netherlands 
 LIVE SCORES - Match 143 - UAE vs Netherlands (ICC Academy, Dubai) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average First Innings Total at ICC Academy, Dubai (ODI's) - 244
 Average Second Innings Total at ICC Academy, Dubai (ODI's) - 216
 Current Form UAE: 
 UAE are currently placed at the bottom most position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 9 wins, 22 losses and 3 No Result Matches to their credit.
 The top run scorer for UAE in the ICC CWC League 2 is Rahul Chopra with 719 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for UAE in the ICC CWC League 2 is Saurabh Netravalkar with 48 scalps under his belt .
 UAE have won their previous match against Oman by 4 wickets.
 Oman batted first and they posted a total of 196 before being bowled out. Jeet Shah, Hammad Mirza and Mujibur Imran Ali all got out without troubling the scorers much. Jatinder Singh tried to play an anchor's role but he kept losing partners in regular succession and the team kept losing momentum gradually. Jatinder Singh made 88 runs before being dismissed by Awais Ali Shah. Shah bowled beautifully. He picked up 5 wickets for 33 runs and wrapped up Oman's lower order. Oman were eventually bowled out for just 196.
 During the chase, UAE lost the key wicket of Tanish Suri quite early. After his dismissal, Aryansh Sharma and Muhammad Shahdad batted really well. Sharma made 49 off 61 balls while Shahdad scored 21 runs to lay the foundation for a successful chase. There were a few hiccups in the form of wickets but Muhammad Waseem had their back in the middle order. He scored 43 runs off just 35 deliveries as UAE managed to get over the line in the 48th over with 4 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Netherlands:  
 Netherlands are currently placed at the 3rd position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 19 wins and 11 losses to their credit.
 The top run scorer for Netherlands in the ICC CWC League 2 is Max O'Dowd with 1170 runs to his name .
 The top wicket taker for Netherlands in the ICC CWC League 2 is Aryan Dutt with 48 scalps under his belt.
 Netherlands have won their previous match against Oman by a big margin of 106 runs.
 Netherlands batted first and they posted a huge total of 371 for 5 in 50 overs. Max O'Dowd and Cedric de Lange started off very well for Netherlands. Max O'Dowd made 63 off only 46 deliveries, collecting 8 fours and 3 sixes while Cedric de Lange scored 102 runs in only 91 deliveries. Bas de Leede also played a captain's knock. He was slow to start with but carted the bowlers to all parts once he got set. He made 145 runs off 110 balls and helped Netherlands get to 371 for 5 in 50 overs of play.
 During the chase, Oman started off well with Jeet Shah and Jatinder Singh stitching a partnership of 35 runs for the 1st wicket. Jeet Shah's dismissal was followed by that of Hammad Mirza and Oman looked in all sorts of bother. Jatinder Singh fought hard and scored 67 runs but the scoreboard pressure wasn't letting him express himself freely. Zikria Islam entertained the crowds with his knock of 77 runs in only 46 balls. However, Oman could come nowhere close to the target as they were bowled out for 265, losing the match by a huge margin of 106 runs.
Let's have a look at the squads:
 Netherlands Squad: Bas de Leede (C), Colin Ackermann, Shariz Ahmad, Noah Croes, Cedric de Lange, Daniel Doram, Aryan Dutt, Scott Edwards, Fred Klaassen, Kyle Klein, Michael Levitt, Zach Lion-Cachet, Max O'Dowd, Tim van der Gugten, Paul van Meekeren
 UAE Squad: Rahul Chopra (C), Aayan Khan, Muhammad Waseem, Awais Ali Shah, Tanish Suri, Muhammad Rohid, Sohaib Khan, Basil Hameed, Junaid Siddique, Akshdeep Nath, Khuzaima Bin Tahir, Aryansh Sharma, Muhammad Arfan, Muhammad Shahad, Adeeb Usmani
